## Objective
- Add an in-game mobile touch button to perform the place-recording action instead of requiring a keyboard.

## Requirements
- Build/apply the change without asking clarifying questions.
- User requested small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px, and reading only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Add a mobile-only RECORD button that is disabled until a field-note location is nearby.
- Keep keyboard controls for desktop; show touch-specific control hints on mobile.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added RECORD button markup and mobile styling in `index.html`.
- Connected the button to `recordSite()` and updated its disabled state and accessible label based on proximity in `game.js`.
- Updated nearby-place and mobile control instructions.

### Active
- Validate the mobile UI and gameplay in a browser; no screenshot has been captured yet.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game and inspect the mobile layout/action behavior; capture a small JPEG if practical.
2. Run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` after any changes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mobile button markup, styles, and touch-specific instructional text.
- `game.js`: Proximity detection and action-button behavior.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Browser binary `/usr/bin/chromium` is available.
